task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for EXT-04 at src/design/ext-04-variable-transformer.md. Define support for CEL-based edge transformer expressions that run when tokens traverse edges. Specify data model and validation rules for optional edge transform expression, including activation-time syntax validation (PD-02/PD-06 path), runtime evaluation context parity with EE-05, execution order constraints (after EE-09 task output merge and before next-node activation), and transform result contract requiring JSON object output. Define error semantics for non-object result or runtime CEL evaluation errors mapped to EE-10. Specify empty transform handling as no-op. Include module boundaries and implementation touchpoints across definition validation, engine transition/traversal, CEL evaluation utilities, and variable merge/error handling. Include complete requirement traceability matrix for EXT-04 acceptance criteria and edge cases with required unit/integration tests. Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design fully maps all EXT-04 acceptance criteria and edge cases to concrete behavior
Activation-time validation and runtime evaluation ordering are explicit and testable
Transform result object-only contract and EE-10 error mapping are precisely defined
Empty transform no-op semantics are clearly specified
Traceability matrix identifies implementation modules and verification hooks

result.summary: Design artefact for EXT-04 variable transformer completed at src/design/ext-04-variable-transformer.md, defining optional edge transform CEL expressions with activation-time validation, EE-05 context parity, strict post-EE-09/pre-activation ordering, object-only output contract merged through EE-09, EE-10 mapping for runtime and non-object failures, explicit empty-transform no-op semantics, and full module/test traceability.
